what: Historical first-party released benchmark summaries for the representation comparison (CADDesigner's claim C1), plus token-cost comparison against an industrial CAD driven through its MCP. Not outputs of this repository's Hardest23 harness; sources below.

replication_vs_cadquery.task: rebuild a part as parametric code from its STEP file
replication_vs_cadquery.parts: 200 real open-hardware parts from 27 projects, 2-1384 mm, median 19 faces
replication_vs_cadquery.protocol: one attempt each, no retries, independent frozen scorer, paired test on the distorted rate
replication_vs_cadquery.disclosure: the SimpleCADAPI group used its STEP-reconstruction workflow guide; the CadQuery group used a general third-party CadQuery skill; parts are mostly simple

badly_wrong_rate.definition: delivered model whose surface F1 at 1 mm is below 99.99%

replication_vs_cadquery.source: released benchmark figures, SimpleCADAPI repository img/benchmark/vs_cadquery.svg (values as published 2026-11-13)

token_cost_vs_industrial_mcp.task: same CAD tasks, agent-driven; industrial CAD through its MCP server; tokens per task (millions)
token_cost_vs_industrial_mcp.source: released benchmark figures, SimpleCADAPI repository img/benchmark/vs_industrial_mcp.svg (2026-11-13)
